summary: 0.15.2 CHANGELOG (Added) says a TableComponent subclass declaring one of the new member names must rename it, but migrations/0.15.2.json has no item for it, so the auto-update run only knows it because the planner read the prose.
proposal: Add a behavior item `table-component-subclass-member-names` (surface typescript, detect `extends TableComponent`, verify: no subclass declares a listed name) to migrations/0.15.2.json.
